text_en: Simon Peter , servant and apostle of Jesus Christ : to them that have obtained equal faith with us in the justice of our God and Saviour Jesus Christ .
text_la: Simon Petrus, servus et apostolus Jesu Christi, iis qui coæqualem nobiscum sortiti sunt fidem in justitia Dei nostri, et Salvatoris Jesu Christi.
text_pt: Simão Pedro, servo e apóstolo de Jesus Cristo, aos que conosco alcançaram fé igualmente preciosa pela justiça do nosso Deus e Salvador Jesus Cristo:
text_el: Σίμων Πέτρος δοῦλος καὶ ἀπόστολος Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ τοῖς ἰσότιμον ἡμῖν λαχοῦσιν πίστιν ἐν δικαιοσύνῃ τοῦ θεοῦ ἡμῶν καὶ σωτῆρος Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ.

text_en: Grace to you and peace be accomplished in the knowledge of God and of Christ Jesus our Lord .
text_la: Gratia vobis, et pax adimpleatur in cognitione Dei, et Christi Jesu Domini nostri:
text_pt: Graça e paz vos sejam multiplicadas, pelo conhecimento de Deus, e de Jesus nosso Senhor;
text_el: χάρις ὑμῖν καὶ εἰρήνη πληθυνθείη ἐν ἐπιγνώσει τοῦ θεοῦ καὶ Ἰησοῦ τοῦ κυρίου ἡμῶν.

text_en: As all things of his divine power which appertain to life and godliness are given us through the knowledge of him who has called us by his own proper glory and virtue .
text_la: Quomodo omnia nobis divinæ virtutis suæ, quæ ad vitam et pietatem donata sunt, per cognitionem ejus, qui vocavit nos propria gloria, et virtute,
text_pt: Visto como o seu divino poder nos deu tudo o que diz respeito à vida e piedade, pelo conhecimento daquele que nos chamou pela sua glória e virtude;
text_el: Ὡς πάντα ἡμῖν τῆς θείας δυνάμεως αὐτοῦ τὰ πρὸς ζωὴν καὶ εὐσέβειαν δεδωρημένης διὰ τῆς ἐπιγνώσεως τοῦ καλέσαντος ἡμᾶς διὰ δόξης καὶ ἀρετῆς,

text_en: By whom he has given us most great and precious promises : that by these you may be made partakers of the divine nature : flying the corruption of that concupiscence which is in the world.
text_la: per quem maxima, et pretiosa nobis promissa donavit : ut per hæc efficiamini divinæ consortes naturæ : fugientes ejus, quæ in mundo est, concupiscentiæ corruptionem.
text_pt: Pelas quais ele nos tem dado grandíssimas e preciosas promessas, para que por elas fiqueis participantes da natureza divina, havendo escapado da corrupção, que pela concupiscência há no mundo.
text_el: δι' ὧν τὰ τίμια καὶ μέγιστα ἡμῖν ἐπαγγέλματα δεδώρηται, ἵνα διὰ τούτων γένησθε θείας κοινωνοὶ φύσεως, ἀποφυγόντες τῆς ἐν τῷ κόσμῳ ἐν ἐπιθυμίᾳ φθορᾶς.

text_en: And you, employing all care, minister in your faith , virtue : And in virtue , knowledge :
text_la: Vos autem curam omnem subinferentes, ministrate in fide vestra virtutem, in virtute autem scientiam,
text_pt: E vós também, pondo nisto mesmo toda a diligência, acrescentai à vossa fé a virtude, e à virtude a ciência,
text_el: καὶ αὐτὸ τοῦτο δὲ σπουδὴν πᾶσαν παρεισενέγκαντες ἐπιχορηγήσατε ἐν τῇ πίστει ὑμῶν τὴν ἀρετήν, ἐν δὲ τῇ ἀρετῇ τὴν γνῶσιν,

text_en: And in knowledge , abstinence: and in abstinence, patience: and in patience, godliness :
text_la: in scientia autem abstinentiam, in abstinentia autem patientiam, in patientia autem pietatem,
text_pt: E à ciência a temperança, e à temperança a paciência, e à paciência a piedade,
text_el: ἐν δὲ τῇ γνώσει τὴν ἐγκράτειαν, ἐν δὲ τῇ ἐγκρατείᾳ τὴν ὑπομονήν, ἐν δὲ τῇ ὑπομονῇ τὴν εὐσέβειαν,

text_en: And in godliness , love of brotherhood: and in love of brotherhood, charity .
text_la: in pietate autem amorem fraternitatis, in amore autem fraternitatis caritatem.
text_pt: E à piedade o amor fraternal, e ao amor fraternal a caridade.
text_el: ἐν δὲ τῇ εὐσεβείᾳ τὴν φιλαδελφίαν, ἐν δὲ τῇ φιλαδελφίᾳ τὴν ἀγάπην.

text_en: For if these things be with you and abound, they will make you to be neither empty nor unfruitful in the knowledge of our Lord Jesus Christ .
text_la: Hæc enim si vobiscum adsint, et superent, non vacuos nec sine fructu vos constituent in Domini nostri Jesu Christi cognitione.
text_pt: Porque, se em vós houver e abundarem estas coisas, não vos deixarão ociosos nem estéreis no conhecimento de nosso Senhor Jesus Cristo.
text_el: ταῦτα γὰρ ὑμῖν ὑπάρχοντα καὶ πλεονάζοντα οὐκ ἀργοὺς οὐδὲ ἀκάρπους καθίστησιν εἰς τὴν τοῦ κυρίου ἡμῶν Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ ἐπίγνωσιν:

text_en: For he that has not these things with him is blind and groping, having forgotten that he was purged from his old sins .
text_la: Cui enim non præsto sunt hæc, cæcus est, et manu tentans, oblivionem accipiens purgationis veterum suorum delictorum.
text_pt: Pois aquele em quem não há estas coisas é cego, nada vendo ao longe, havendo-se esquecido da purificação dos seus antigos pecados.
text_el: ᾧ γὰρ μὴ πάρεστιν ταῦτα, τυφλός ἐστιν μυωπάζων, λήθην λαβὼν τοῦ καθαρισμοῦ τῶν πάλαι αὐτοῦ ἁμαρτιῶν.

text_en: Wherefore, brethren, labour the more, that by good works you may make sure your calling and election . For doing these things, you shall not sin at any time.
text_la: Quapropter fratres, magis satagite ut per bona opera certam vestram vocationem, et electionem faciatis : hæc enim facientes, non peccabitis aliquando.
text_pt: Portanto, irmãos, procurai fazer cada vez mais firme a vossa vocação e eleição; porque, fazendo isto, nunca jamais tropeçareis.
text_el: διὸ μᾶλλον, ἀδελφοί, σπουδάσατε βεβαίαν ὑμῶν τὴν κλῆσιν καὶ ἐκλογὴν ποιεῖσθαι: ταῦτα γὰρ ποιοῦντες οὐ μὴ πταίσητέ ποτε:

text_en: For so an entrance shall be ministered to you abundantly into the ever-lasting kingdom of our Lord and Saviour Jesus Christ .
text_la: Sic enim abundanter ministrabitur vobis introitus in æternum regnum Domini nostri et Salvatoris Jesu Christi.
text_pt: Porque assim vos será amplamente concedida a entrada no reino eterno de nosso Senhor e Salvador Jesus Cristo.
text_el: οὕτως γὰρ πλουσίως ἐπιχορηγηθήσεται ὑμῖν ἡ εἴσοδος εἰς τὴν αἰώνιον βασιλείαν τοῦ κυρίου ἡμῶν καὶ σωτῆρος Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ.

text_en: For which cause, I will begin to put you always in remembrance of these things: though indeed you know them and are confirmed in the present truth .
text_la: Propter quod incipiam vos semper commonere de his: et quidem scientes et confirmatos vos in præsenti veritate.
text_pt: Por isso não deixarei de exortar-vos sempre acerca destas coisas, ainda que bem as saibais, e estejais confirmados na presente verdade.
text_el: Διὸ μελλήσω ἀεὶ ὑμᾶς ὑπομιμνῄσκειν περὶ τούτων, καίπερ εἰδότας καὶ ἐστηριγμένους ἐν τῇ παρούσῃ ἀληθείᾳ.

text_en: But I think it meet, as long as I am in this tabernacle, to stir you up by putting you in remembrance.
text_la: Justum autem arbitror quamdiu sum in hoc tabernaculo, suscitare vos in commonitione:
text_pt: E tenho por justo, enquanto estiver neste tabernáculo, despertar-vos com admoestações,
text_el: δίκαιον δὲ ἡγοῦμαι, ἐφ' ὅσον εἰμὶ ἐν τούτῳ τῷ σκηνώματι, διεγείρειν ὑμᾶς ἐν ὑπομνήσει,

text_en: Being assured that the laying away of this my tabernacle is at hand, according as our Lord Jesus Christ also has signified to me.
text_la: certus quod velox est depositio tabernaculi mei secundum quod et Dominus noster Jesus Christus significavit mihi.
text_pt: Sabendo que brevemente hei de deixar este meu tabernáculo, como também nosso Senhor Jesus Cristo já mo tem revelado.
text_el: εἰδὼς ὅτι ταχινή ἐστιν ἡ ἀπόθεσις τοῦ σκηνώματός μου, καθὼς καὶ ὁ κύριος ἡμῶν Ἰησοῦς Χριστὸς ἐδήλωσέν μοι:

text_en: And I will endeavour that you frequently have after my decease whereby you may keep a memory of these things.
text_la: Dabo autem operam et frequenter habere vos post obitum meum, ut horum memoriam faciatis.
text_pt: Mas também eu procurarei em toda a ocasião que depois da minha morte tenhais lembrança destas coisas.
text_el: σπουδάσω δὲ καὶ ἑκάστοτε ἔχειν ὑμᾶς μετὰ τὴν ἐμὴν ἔξοδον τὴν τούτων μνήμην ποιεῖσθαι.

text_en: For we have not by following artificial fables made known to you the power and presence of our Lord Jesus Christ : but we were eyewitnesses of his greatness .
text_la: Non enim doctas fabulas secuti notam fecimus vobis Domini nostri Jesu Christi virtutem et præsentiam : sed speculatores facti illius magnitudinis.
text_pt: Porque não vos fizemos saber a virtude e a vinda de nosso Senhor Jesus Cristo, seguindo fábulas artificialmente compostas; mas nós mesmos vimos a sua majestade.
text_el: οὐ γὰρ σεσοφισμένοις μύθοις ἐξακολουθήσαντες ἐγνωρίσαμεν ὑμῖν τὴν τοῦ κυρίου ἡμῶν Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ δύναμιν καὶ παρουσίαν, ἀλλ' ἐπόπται γενηθέντες τῆς ἐκείνου μεγαλειότητος.

text_en: For he received from God the Father honour and glory , this voice coming down to him from the excellent glory : This is my beloved Son , in whom I am well pleased. Hear him.
text_la: Accipiens enim a Deo Patre honorem et gloriam, voce delapsa ad eum hujuscemodi a magnifica gloria : Hic est Filius meus dilectus, in quo mihi complacui, ipsum audite.
text_pt: Porquanto ele recebeu de Deus Pai honra e glória, quando da magnífica glória lhe foi dirigida a seguinte voz: Este é o meu Filho amado, em quem me tenho comprazido.
text_el: λαβὼν γὰρ παρὰ θεοῦ πατρὸς τιμὴν καὶ δόξαν φωνῆς ἐνεχθείσης αὐτῷ τοιᾶσδε ὑπὸ τῆς μεγαλοπρεποῦς δόξης: Ὁ υἱός μου ὁ ἀγαπητός μου οὗτός ἐστιν, εἰς ὃν ἐγὼ εὐδόκησα.

text_en: And this voice, we heard brought from heaven , when we were with him in the holy mount .
text_la: Et hanc vocem nos audivimus de cælo allatam, cum essemus cum ipso in monte sancto.
text_pt: E ouvimos esta voz dirigida do céu, estando nós com ele no monte santo;
text_el: καὶ ταύτην τὴν φωνὴν ἡμεῖς ἠκούσαμεν ἐξ οὐρανοῦ ἐνεχθεῖσαν σὺν αὐτῷ ὄντες ἐν τῷ ἁγίῳ ὄρει.

text_en: And we have the more firm prophetical word: whereunto you do well to attend, as to a light that shines in a dark place, until the day dawn and the day star arise in your hearts.
text_la: Et habemus firmiorem propheticum sermonem : cui benefacitis attendentes quasi lucernæ lucenti in caliginoso loco donec dies elucescat, et lucifer oriatur in cordibus vestris:
text_pt: E temos, mui firme, a palavra dos profetas, à qual bem fazeis em estar atentos, como a uma luz que alumia em lugar escuro, até que o dia amanheça, e a estrela da alva apareça em vossos corações.
text_el: καὶ ἔχομεν βεβαιότερον τὸν προφητικὸν λόγον, ᾧ καλῶς ποιεῖτε προσέχοντες ὡς λύχνῳ φαίνοντι ἐν αὐχμηρῷ τόπῳ, ἕως οὗ ἡμέρα διαυγάσῃ καὶ φωσφόρος ἀνατείλῃ ἐν ταῖς καρδίαις ὑμῶν:

text_en: Understanding this first: That no prophecy of scripture is made by private interpretation.
text_la: hoc primum intelligentes quod omnis prophetia Scripturæ propria interpretatione non fit.
text_pt: Sabendo primeiramente isto: que nenhuma profecia da Escritura é de particular interpretação.
text_el: τοῦτο πρῶτον γινώσκοντες, ὅτι πᾶσα προφητεία γραφῆς ἰδίας ἐπιλύσεως οὐ γίνεται:

text_en: For prophecy came not by the will of man at any time: but the holy men of God spoke, inspired by the Holy Ghost .
text_la: Non enim voluntate humana allata est aliquando prophetia : sed Spiritu Sancto inspirati, locuti sunt sancti Dei homines.
text_pt: Porque a profecia nunca foi produzida por vontade de homem algum, mas os homens santos de Deus falaram inspirados pelo Espírito Santo.
text_el: οὐ γὰρ θελήματι ἀνθρώπου ἠνέχθη προφητεία ποτέ, ἀλλὰ ὑπὸ πνεύματος ἁγίου φερόμενοι ἐλάλησαν ἀπὸ θεοῦ ἄνθρωποι.

text_en: But there were also false prophets among the people, even as there shall be among you lying teachers who shall bring in sects of perdition and deny the Lord who bought them: bringing upon themselves swift destruction.
text_la: Fuerunt vero et pseudoprophetæ in populo, sicut et in vobis erunt magistri mendaces, qui introducent sectas perditionis : et eum qui emit eos, Dominum negant, superducentes sibi celerem perditionem.
text_pt: E também houve entre o povo falsos profetas, como entre vós haverá também falsos doutores, que introduzirão encobertamente heresias de perdição, e negarão o Senhor que os resgatou, trazendo sobre si mesmos repentina perdição.
text_el: Ἐγένοντο δὲ καὶ ψευδοπροφῆται ἐν τῷ λαῷ, ὡς καὶ ἐν ὑμῖν ἔσονται ψευδοδιδάσκαλοι, οἵτινες παρεισάξουσιν αἱρέσεις ἀπωλείας, καὶ τὸν ἀγοράσαντα αὐτοὺς δεσπότην ἀρνούμενοι, ἐπάγοντες ἑαυτοῖς ταχινὴν ἀπώλειαν.

text_en: And many shall follow their riotousness, through whom the way of truth shall be evil spoken of.
text_la: Et multi sequentur eorum luxurias, per quos via veritatis blasphemabitur:
text_pt: E muitos seguirão as suas dissoluções, pelos quais será blasfemado o caminho da verdade.
text_el: καὶ πολλοὶ ἐξακολουθήσουσιν αὐτῶν ταῖς ἀσελγείαις, δι' οὓς ἡ ὁδὸς τῆς ἀληθείας βλασφημηθήσεται:

text_en: And through covetousness shall they with feigned words make merchandise of you. Whose judgment now of a long time lingers not: and their perdition slumbers not.
text_la: et in avaritia fictis verbis de vobis negotiabuntur : quibus judicium jam olim non cessat : et perditio eorum non dormitat.
text_pt: E por avareza farão de vós negócio com palavras fingidas; sobre os quais já de largo tempo não será tardia a sentença, e a sua perdição não dormita.
text_el: καὶ ἐν πλεονεξίᾳ πλαστοῖς λόγοις ὑμᾶς ἐμπορεύσονται: οἷς τὸ κρίμα ἔκπαλαι οὐκ ἀργεῖ, καὶ ἡ ἀπώλεια αὐτῶν οὐ νυστάζει.

text_en: For if God spared not the angels that sinned , but delivered them, drawn down by infernal ropes to the lower hell , unto torments, to be reserved unto judgment :
text_la: Si enim Deus angelis peccantibus non pepercit, sed rudentibus inferni detractos in tartarum tradidit cruciandos, in judicium reservari.
text_pt: Porque, se Deus não perdoou aos anjos que pecaram, mas, havendo-os lançado no inferno, os entregou às cadeias da escuridão, ficando reservados para o juízo;
text_el: εἰ γὰρ ὁ θεὸς ἀγγέλων ἁμαρτησάντων οὐκ ἐφείσατο, ἀλλὰ σειροῖς ζόφου ταρταρώσας παρέδωκεν εἰς κρίσιν τηρουμένους,

text_en: And spared not the original world, but preserved Noe , the eighth person, the preacher of justice , bringing in the flood upon the world of the ungodly.
text_la: Et originali mundo non pepercit, sed octavum Noë justitiæ præconem custodivit, diluvium mundo impiorum inducens.
text_pt: E não perdoou ao mundo antigo, mas guardou a Noé, a oitava pessoa, o pregoeiro da justiça, ao trazer o dilúvio sobre o mundo dos ímpios;
text_el: καὶ ἀρχαίου κόσμου οὐκ ἐφείσατο, ἀλλὰ ὄγδοον Νῶε δικαιοσύνης κήρυκα ἐφύλαξεν, κατακλυσμὸν κόσμῳ ἀσεβῶν ἐπάξας,

text_en: And reducing the cities of the Sodomites and of the Gomorrhites into ashes, condemned them to be overthrown, making them an example to those that should after act wickedly ,
text_la: Et civitates Sodomorum et Gomorrhæorum in cinerem redigens, eversione damnavit : exemplum eorum, qui impie acturi sunt, ponens:
text_pt: E condenou à destruição as cidades de Sodoma e Gomorra, reduzindo-as a cinza, e pondo-as para exemplo aos que vivessem impiamente;
text_el: καὶ πόλεις Σοδόμων καὶ Γομόρρας τεφρώσας κατέκρινεν, ὑπόδειγμα μελλόντων ἀσεβέσιν τεθεικώς,

text_en: and delivered just Lot , oppressed by the injustice and lewd conversation of the wicked :
text_la: et justum Lot oppressum a nefandorum injuria, ac luxuriosa conversatione eripuit:
text_pt: E livrou o justo Ló, enfadado da vida dissoluta dos homens abomináveis
text_el: καὶ δίκαιον Λὼτ καταπονούμενον ὑπὸ τῆς τῶν ἀθέσμων ἐν ἀσελγείᾳ ἀναστροφῆς ἐρρύσατο:

text_en: For in sight and hearing he was just , dwelling among them who from day to day vexed the just soul with unjust works .
text_la: aspectu enim, et auditu justus erat : habitans apud eos, qui de die in diem animam justam iniquis operibus cruciabant.
text_pt: (Porque este justo, habitando entre eles, afligia todos os dias a sua alma justa, por isso via e ouvia sobre as suas obras injustas);
text_el: βλέμματι γὰρ καὶ ἀκοῇ δίκαιος ἐγκατοικῶν ἐν αὐτοῖς ἡμέραν ἐξ ἡμέρας ψυχὴν δικαίαν ἀνόμοις ἔργοις ἐβασάνιζεν:

text_en: The Lord knows how to deliver the godly from temptation , but to reserve the unjust unto the day of judgment to be tormented:
text_la: Novit Dominus pios de tentatione eripere : iniquos vero in diem judicii reservare cruciandos.
text_pt: Assim, sabe o Senhor livrar da tentação os piedosos, e reservar os injustos para o dia do juízo, para serem castigados;
text_el: οἶδεν κύριος εὐσεβεῖς ἐκ πειρασμοῦ ῥύεσθαι, ἀδίκους δὲ εἰς ἡμέραν κρίσεως κολαζομένους τηρεῖν,

text_en: And especially them who walk after the flesh in the lust of uncleanness and despise government: audacious, self willed, they fear not to bring in sects , blaspheming .
text_la: Magis autem eos, qui post carnem in concupiscentia immunditiæ ambulant, dominationemque contemnunt, audaces, sibi placentes, sectas non metuunt introducere blasphemantes:
text_pt: Mas principalmente aqueles que segundo a carne andam em concupiscências de imundícia, e desprezam as autoridades; atrevidos, obstinados, não receando blasfemar das dignidades;
text_el: μάλιστα δὲ τοὺς ὀπίσω σαρκὸς ἐν ἐπιθυμίᾳ μιασμοῦ πορευομένους καὶ κυριότητος καταφρονοῦντας. τολμηταί, αὐθάδεις, δόξας οὐ τρέμουσιν βλασφημοῦντες,

text_en: Whereas angels , who are greater in strength and power, bring not against themselves a railing judgment.
text_la: ubi angeli fortitudine, et virtute cum sint majores, non portant adversum se execrabile judicium.
text_pt: Enquanto os anjos, sendo maiores em força e poder, não pronunciam contra eles juízo blasfemo diante do Senhor.
text_el: ὅπου ἄγγελοι ἰσχύϊ καὶ δυνάμει μείζονες ὄντες οὐ φέρουσιν κατ' αὐτῶν [παρὰ κυρίῳ] βλάσφημον κρίσιν.

text_en: But these men , as irrational beasts, naturally tending to the snare and to destruction, blaspheming those things which they know not, shall perish in their corruption:
text_la: Hi vero velut irrationabilia pecora, naturaliter in captionem, et in perniciem in his quæ ignorant blasphemantes in corruptione sua peribunt,
text_pt: Mas estes, como animais irracionais, que seguem a natureza, feitos para serem presos e mortos, blasfemando do que não entendem, perecerão na sua corrupção,
text_el: οὗτοι δέ, ὡς ἄλογα ζῷα γεγεννημένα φυσικὰ εἰς ἅλωσιν καὶ φθοράν, ἐν οἷς ἀγνοοῦσιν βλασφημοῦντες, ἐν τῇ φθορᾷ αὐτῶν καὶ φθαρήσονται,

text_en: Receiving the reward of their injustice , counting for a pleasure the delights of a day: stains and spots, sporting themselves to excess, rioting in their feasts with you:
text_la: percipientes mercedem injustitiæ, voluptatem existimantes diei delicias : coinquinationes, et maculæ deliciis affluentes, in conviviis suis luxuriantes vobiscum,
text_pt: Recebendo o galardão da injustiça; pois que tais homens têm prazer nos deleites quotidianos; nódoas são eles e máculas, deleitando-se em seus enganos, quando se banqueteiam convosco;
text_el: ἀδικούμενοι μισθὸν ἀδικίας: ἡδονὴν ἡγούμενοι τὴν ἐν ἡμέρᾳ τρυφήν, σπίλοι καὶ μῶμοι ἐντρυφῶντες ἐν ταῖς ἀπάταις αὐτῶν συνευωχούμενοι ὑμῖν,

text_en: Having eyes full of adultery and of sin that ceases not: alluring unstable souls : having their heart exercised with covetousness : children of malediction .
text_la: oculos habentes plenos adulterii, et incessabilis delicti. Pellicientes animas instabiles, cor exercitatum avaritia habentes, maledictionis filii:
text_pt: Tendo os olhos cheios de adultério, e não cessando de pecar, engodando as almas inconstantes, tendo o coração exercitado na avareza, filhos de maldição;
text_el: ὀφθαλμοὺς ἔχοντες μεστοὺς μοιχαλίδος καὶ ἀκαταπάστους ἁμαρτίας, δελεάζοντες ψυχὰς ἀστηρίκτους, καρδίαν γεγυμνασμένην πλεονεξίας ἔχοντες, κατάρας τέκνα,

text_en: Leaving the right way, they have gone astray, having followed the way of Balaam of Bosor who loved the wages of iniquity ,
text_la: derelinquentes rectam viam erraverunt, secuti viam Balaam ex Bosor, qui mercedem iniquitatis amavit:
text_pt: Os quais, deixando o caminho direito, erraram seguindo o caminho de Balaão, filho de Beor, que amou o prêmio da injustiça;
text_el: καταλείποντες εὐθεῖαν ὁδὸν ἐπλανήθησαν, ἐξακολουθήσαντες τῇ ὁδῷ τοῦ Βαλαὰμ τοῦ Βεὼρ ὃς μισθὸν ἀδικίας ἠγάπησεν

text_en: but had a check of his madness , the dumb beast used to the yoke, which, speaking with man's voice, forbade the folly of the prophet .
text_la: correptionem vero habuit suæ vesaniæ : subjugale mutum animal, hominis voce loquens, prohibuit prophetæ insipientiam.
text_pt: Mas teve a repreensão da sua transgressão; o mudo jumento, falando com voz humana, impediu a loucura do profeta.
text_el: ἔλεγξιν δὲ ἔσχεν ἰδίας παρανομίας: ὑποζύγιον ἄφωνον ἐν ἀνθρώπου φωνῇ φθεγξάμενον ἐκώλυσεν τὴν τοῦ προφήτου παραφρονίαν.

text_en: These are fountains without water and clouds tossed with whirlwinds, to whom the mist of darkness is reserved.
text_la: Hi sunt fontes sine aqua, et nebulæ turbinibus exagitatæ, quibus caligo tenebrarum reservatur.
text_pt: Estes são fontes sem água, nuvens levadas pela força do vento, para os quais a escuridão das trevas eternamente se reserva.
text_el: οὗτοί εἰσιν πηγαὶ ἄνυδροι καὶ ὁμίχλαι ὑπὸ λαίλαπος ἐλαυνόμεναι, οἷς ὁ ζόφος τοῦ σκότους τετήρηται.

text_en: For, speaking proud words of vanity, they allure by the desires of fleshly riotousness those who for a little while escape, such as converse in error :
text_la: Superba enim vanitatis loquentes, pelliciunt in desideriis carnis luxuriæ eos, qui paululum effugiunt, qui in errore conversantur:
text_pt: Porque, falando coisas mui arrogantes de vaidades, engodam com as concupiscências da carne, e com dissoluções, aqueles que se estavam afastando dos que andam em erro,
text_el: ὑπέρογκα γὰρ ματαιότητος φθεγγόμενοι δελεάζουσιν ἐν ἐπιθυμίαις σαρκὸς ἀσελγείαις τοὺς ὀλίγως ἀποφεύγοντας τοὺς ἐν πλάνῃ ἀναστρεφομένους,

text_en: Promising them liberty, whereas they themselves are the slaves of corruption. For by whom a man is overcome, of the same also he is the slave.
text_la: libertatem illis promittentes, cum ipsi servi sint corruptionem : a quo enim quis superatus est, hujus et servus est.
text_pt: Prometendo-lhes liberdade, sendo eles mesmos servos da corrupção. Porque de quem alguém é vencido, do tal faz-se também servo.
text_el: ἐλευθερίαν αὐτοῖς ἐπαγγελλόμενοι, αὐτοὶ δοῦλοι ὑπάρχοντες τῆς φθορᾶς: ᾧ γάρ τις ἥττηται, τούτῳ δεδούλωται.

text_en: For if, flying from the pollutions of the world, through the knowledge of our Lord and Saviour Jesus Christ , they be again entangled in them and overcome: their latter state has become unto them worse than the former.
text_la: Si enim refugientes coinquinationes mundi in cognitione Domini nostri, et Salvatoris Jesu Christi, his rursus implicati superantur : facta sunt eis posteriora deteriora prioribus.
text_pt: Porquanto se, depois de terem escapado das corrupções do mundo, pelo conhecimento do Senhor e Salvador Jesus Cristo, forem outra vez envolvidos nelas e vencidos, tornou-se-lhes o último estado pior do que o primeiro.
text_el: εἰ γὰρ ἀποφυγόντες τὰ μιάσματα τοῦ κόσμου ἐν ἐπιγνώσει τοῦ κυρίου καὶ σωτῆρος Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ τούτοις δὲ πάλιν ἐμπλακέντες ἡττῶνται, γέγονεν αὐτοῖς τὰ ἔσχατα χείρονα τῶν πρώτων.

text_en: For it had been better for them not to have known the way of justice than, after they have known it, to turn back from that holy commandment which was delivered to them.
text_la: Melius enim erat illis non cognoscere viam justitiæ, quam post agnitionem, retrorsum converti ab eo, quod illis traditum est, sancto mandato.
text_pt: Porque melhor lhes fora não conhecerem o caminho da justiça, do que, conhecendo-o, desviarem-se do santo mandamento que lhes fora dado;
text_el: κρεῖττον γὰρ ἦν αὐτοῖς μὴ ἐπεγνωκέναι τὴν ὁδὸν τῆς δικαιοσύνης ἢ ἐπιγνοῦσιν ὑποστρέψαι ἐκ τῆς παραδοθείσης αὐτοῖς ἁγίας ἐντολῆς.

text_en: For, that of the true proverb has happened to them: The dog is returned to his vomit; and: The sow that was washed to her wallowing in the mire.
text_la: Contigit enim eis illud veri proverbii : Canis reversus ad suum vomitum : et, Sus lota in volutabro luti.
text_pt: Deste modo sobreveio-lhes o que por um verdadeiro provérbio se diz: O cão voltou ao seu próprio vômito, e a porca lavada ao espojadouro de lama.
text_el: συμβέβηκεν αὐτοῖς τὸ τῆς ἀληθοῦς παροιμίας, κύων ἐπιστρέψας ἐπὶ τὸ ἴδιον ἐξέραμα, καί, ὗς λουσαμένη εἰς κυλισμὸν βορβόρου.

text_en: Behold this second epistle I write to you, my dearly beloved, in which, I stir up by way of admonition your sincere mind :
text_la: Hanc ecce vobis, carissimi, secundam scribo epistolam, in quibus vestram excito in commonitione sinceram mentem:
text_pt: Amados, escrevo-vos agora esta segunda carta, em ambas as quais desperto com exortação o vosso ânimo sincero;
text_el: Ταύτην ἤδη, ἀγαπητοί, δευτέραν ὑμῖν γράφω ἐπιστολήν, ἐν αἷς διεγείρω ὑμῶν ἐν ὑπομνήσει τὴν εἰλικρινῆ διάνοιαν,

text_en: That you may be mindful of those words which I told you before from the holy prophet and of your apostles , of the precepts of the Lord and Saviour .
text_la: ut memores sitis eorum, quæ prædixi, verborum, a sanctis prophetis et apostolorum vestrorum, præceptorum Domini et Salvatoris.
text_pt: Para que vos lembreis das palavras que primeiramente foram ditas pelos santos profetas, e do nosso mandamento, como apòstolos do Senhor e Salvador.
text_el: μνησθῆναι τῶν προειρημένων ῥημάτων ὑπὸ τῶν ἁγίων προφητῶν καὶ τῆς τῶν ἀποστόλων ὑμῶν ἐντολῆς τοῦ κυρίου καὶ σωτῆρος:

text_en: Knowing this first: That in the last days there shall come deceitful scoffers, walking after their own lusts ,
text_la: Hoc primum scientes, quod venient in novissimis diebus in deceptione illusores, juxta proprias concupiscentias ambulantes,
text_pt: Sabendo primeiro isto, que nos últimos dias virão escarnecedores, andando segundo as suas próprias concupiscências,
text_el: τοῦτο πρῶτον γινώσκοντες, ὅτι ἐλεύσονται ἐπ' ἐσχάτων τῶν ἡμερῶν ἐν ἐμπαιγμονῇ ἐμπαῖκται κατὰ τὰς ἰδίας ἐπιθυμίας αὐτῶν πορευόμενοι

text_en: saying: Where is his promise or his coming? For since the time that the fathers slept, all things continue as they were from the beginning of the creation .
text_la: dicentes : Ubi est promissio, aut adventus ejus? ex quo enim patres dormierunt, omnia sic perseverant ab initio creaturæ.
text_pt: E dizendo: Onde está a promessa da sua vinda? porque desde que os pais dormiram, todas as coisas permanecem como desde o princípio da criação.
text_el: καὶ λέγοντες, ποῦ ἐστιν ἡ ἐπαγγελία τῆς παρουσίας αὐτοῦ; ἀφ' ἧς γὰρ οἱ πατέρες ἐκοιμήθησαν, πάντα οὕτως διαμένει ἀπ' ἀρχῆς κτίσεως.

text_en: For this they are wilfully ignorant of: That the heavens were before, and the earth out of water and through water, consisting by the word of God :
text_la: Latet enim eos hoc volentes, quod cæli erant prius, et terra de aqua, et per aquam consistens Dei verbo:
text_pt: Eles voluntariamente ignoram isto, que pela palavra de Deus já desde a antiguidade existiram os céus, e a terra, que foi tirada da água e no meio da água subsiste.
text_el: λανθάνει γὰρ αὐτοὺς τοῦτο θέλοντας, ὅτι οὐρανοὶ ἦσαν ἔκπαλαι καὶ γῆ ἐξ ὕδατος καὶ δι' ὕδατος συνεστῶσα τῷ τοῦ θεοῦ λόγῳ,

text_en: Whereby the world that then was, being overflowed with water, perished.
text_la: per quæ, ille tunc mundus aqua inundatus, periit.
text_pt: Pelas quais coisas pereceu o mundo de então, coberto com as águas do dilúvio,
text_el: δι' ὧν ὁ τότε κόσμος ὕδατι κατακλυσθεὶς ἀπώλετο:

text_en: But the heavens and the earth which are now, by the same word are kept in store, reserved unto fire against the day of judgment and perdition of the ungodly men .
text_la: Cæli autem, qui nunc sunt, et terra eodem verbo repositi sunt, igni reservati in diem judicii, et perditionis impiorum hominum.
text_pt: Mas os céus e a terra que agora existem pela mesma palavra se reservam como tesouro, e se guardam para o fogo, até o dia do juízo, e da perdição dos homens ímpios.
text_el: οἱ δὲ νῦν οὐρανοὶ καὶ ἡ γῆ τῷ αὐτῷ λόγῳ τεθησαυρισμένοι εἰσὶν πυρί, τηρούμενοι εἰς ἡμέραν κρίσεως καὶ ἀπωλείας τῶν ἀσεβῶν ἀνθρώπων.

text_en: But of this one thing be not ignorant , my beloved, that one day with the Lord is as a thousand years, and a thousand years as one day.
text_la: Unum vero hoc non lateat vos, carissimi, quia unus dies apud Dominum sicut mille anni, et mille anni sicut dies unus.
text_pt: Mas, amados, não ignoreis uma coisa, que um dia para o Senhor é como mil anos, e mil anos como um dia.
text_el: ἓν δὲ τοῦτο μὴ λανθανέτω ὑμᾶς, ἀγαπητοί, ὅτι μία ἡμέρα παρὰ κυρίῳ ὡς χίλια ἔτη καὶ χίλια ἔτη ὡς ἡμέρα μία.

text_en: The Lord delays not his promise , as some imagine, but deals patiently for your sake, not willing that any should perish, but that all should return to penance ,
text_la: Non tardat Dominus promissionem suam, sicut quidam existimant : sed patienter agit propter vos, nolens aliquos perire, sed omnes ad pœnitentiam reverti.
text_pt: O Senhor não retarda a sua promessa, ainda que alguns a têm por tardia; mas é longânimo para conosco, não querendo que alguns se percam, senão que todos venham a arrepender-se.
text_el: οὐ βραδύνει κύριος τῆς ἐπαγγελίας, ὥς τινες βραδύτητα ἡγοῦνται, ἀλλὰ μακροθυμεῖ εἰς' ὑμᾶς, μὴ βουλόμενός τινας ἀπολέσθαι ἀλλὰ πάντας εἰς μετάνοιαν χωρῆσαι.

text_en: but the day of the Lord shall come as a thief , in which the heavens shall pass away with great violence and the elements shall be melted with heat and the earth and the works which are in it shall be burnt up.
text_la: Adveniet autem dies Domini ut fur : in quo cæli magno impetu transient, elementa vero calore solventur, terra autem et quæ in ipsa sunt opera, exurentur.
text_pt: Mas o dia do Senhor virá como o ladrão de noite; no qual os céus passarão com grande estrondo, e os elementos, ardendo, se desfarão, e a terra, e as obras que nela há, se queimarão.
text_el: Ἥξει δὲ ἡμέρα κυρίου ὡς κλέπτης, ἐν ᾗ οἱ οὐρανοὶ ῥοιζηδὸν παρελεύσονται, στοιχεῖα δὲ καυσούμενα λυθήσεται, καὶ γῆ καὶ τὰ ἐν αὐτῇ ἔργα εὑρεθήσεται.

text_en: Seeing then that all these things are to be dissolved, what manner of people ought you to be in holy conversation and godliness ?
text_la: Cum igitur hæc omnia dissolvenda sunt, quales oportet vos esse in sanctis conversationibus, et pietatibus,
text_pt: Havendo, pois, de perecer todas estas coisas, que pessoas vos convém ser em santo trato, e piedade,
text_el: τούτων οὕτως πάντων λυομένων ποταποὺς δεῖ ὑπάρχειν ὑμᾶς ἐν ἁγίαις ἀναστροφαῖς καὶ εὐσεβείαις,

text_en: Looking for and hasting unto the coming of the day of the Lord , by which the heavens being on fire shall be dissolved, and the elements shall melt with the burning heat?
text_la: exspectantes, et properantes in adventum diei Domini, per quem cæli ardentes solventur, et elementa ignis ardore tabescent?
text_pt: Aguardando, e apressando-vos para a vinda do dia de Deus, em que os céus, em fogo se desfarão, e os elementos, ardendo, se fundirão?
text_el: προσδοκῶντας καὶ σπεύδοντας τὴν παρουσίαν τῆς τοῦ θεοῦ ἡμέρας, δι' ἣν οὐρανοὶ πυρούμενοι λυθήσονται καὶ στοιχεῖα καυσούμενα τήκεται.

text_en: But we look for new heavens and a new earth according to his promises , in which justice dwells.
text_la: Novos vero cælos, et novam terram secundum promissa ipsius exspectamus, in quibus justitia habitat.
text_pt: Mas nós, segundo a sua promessa, aguardamos novos céus e nova terra, em que habita a justiça.
text_el: καινοὺς δὲ οὐρανοὺς καὶ γῆν καινὴν κατὰ τὸ ἐπάγγελμα αὐτοῦ προσδοκῶμεν, ἐν οἷς δικαιοσύνη κατοικεῖ.

text_en: Wherefore, dearly beloved, waiting for these things, be diligent that you may be found before him unspotted and blameless in peace.
text_la: Propter quod, carissimi, hæc exspectantes, satagite immaculati, et inviolati ei inveniri in pace:
text_pt: Por isso, amados, aguardando estas coisas, procurai que dele sejais achados imaculados e irrepreensíveis em paz.
text_el: διό, ἀγαπητοί, ταῦτα προσδοκῶντες σπουδάσατε ἄσπιλοι καὶ ἀμώμητοι αὐτῷ εὑρεθῆναι ἐν εἰρήνῃ,

text_en: And account the longsuffering of our Lord , salvation : as also our most dear brother Paul , according to the wisdom given him, has written to you:
text_la: et Domini nostri longanimitatem, salutem arbitremini : sicut et carissimus frater noster Paulus secundum datam sibi sapientiam scripsit vobis,
text_pt: E tende por salvação a longanimidade de nosso Senhor; como também o nosso amado irmão Paulo vos escreveu, segundo a sabedoria que lhe foi dada;
text_el: καὶ τὴν τοῦ κυρίου ἡμῶν μακροθυμίαν σωτηρίαν ἡγεῖσθε, καθὼς καὶ ὁ ἀγαπητὸς ἡμῶν ἀδελφὸς Παῦλος κατὰ τὴν δοθεῖσαν αὐτῷ σοφίαν ἔγραψεν ὑμῖν,

text_en: As also in all his epistles , speaking in them of these things; in which are certain things hard to be understood, which the unlearned and unstable wrest, as they do also the other scriptures , to their own destruction.
text_la: sicut et omnibus epistolis, loquens in eis de his in quibus sunt quædam difficilia intellectu, quæ indocti et instabiles depravant, sicut et ceteras Scripturas, ad suam ipsorum perditionem.
text_pt: Falando disto, como em todas as suas epístolas, entre as quais há pontos difíceis de entender, que os indoutos e inconstantes torcem, e igualmente as outras Escrituras, para sua própria perdição.
text_el: ὡς καὶ ἐν πάσαις ἐπιστολαῖς λαλῶν ἐν αὐταῖς περὶ τούτων, ἐν αἷς ἐστιν δυσνόητά τινα, ἃ οἱ ἀμαθεῖς καὶ ἀστήρικτοι στρεβλοῦσιν ὡς καὶ τὰς λοιπὰς γραφὰς πρὸς τὴν ἰδίαν αὐτῶν ἀπώλειαν.

text_en: You therefore, brethren, knowing these things before, take heed, lest being led aside by the error of the unwise, you fall from your own steadfastness.
text_la: Vos igitur fratres, præscientes custodite, ne insipientium errore traducti excidatis a propria firmitate:
text_pt: Vós, portanto, amados, sabendo isto de antemão, guardai-vos de que, pelo engano dos homens abomináveis, sejais juntamente arrebatados, e descaiais da vossa firmeza;
text_el: ὑμεῖς οὖν, ἀγαπητοί, προγινώσκοντες φυλάσσεσθε ἵνα μὴ τῇ τῶν ἀθέσμων πλάνῃ συναπαχθέντες ἐκπέσητε τοῦ ἰδίου στηριγμοῦ,

text_en: But grow in grace and in the knowledge of our Lord and Saviour Jesus Christ . To him be glory both now and unto the day of eternity , Amen .
text_la: crescite vero in gratia, et in cognitione Domini nostri, et Salvatoris Jesu Christi. Ipsi gloria et nunc, et in diem æternitatis. Amen.
text_pt: Antes crescei na graça e conhecimento de nosso Senhor e Salvador, Jesus Cristo. A ele seja dada a glória, assim agora, como no dia da eternidade. Amém.
text_el: αὐξάνετε δὲ ἐν χάριτι καὶ γνώσει τοῦ κυρίου ἡμῶν καὶ σωτῆρος Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ. αὐτῷ ἡ δόξα καὶ νῦν καὶ εἰς ἡμέραν αἰῶνος.
